string.name: guide_record_intro
string.value: The stream is compressed into an MP4 (H.265) on this device as it arrives, separately from what is on screen.

string.name: guide_record_live_body
string.value: While streaming, open the menu at the top center and tap Record; tap it again to stop. A red dot and the time show at the top right, and the notification bar shows the time and size too. Recording continues in the background or with the screen locked.

string.name: guide_record_only_body
string.value: Choose Record only from the menu at the top right of a console card (for USB, touch and hold its card). Nothing is shown or played; recording starts once the picture arrives. You can leave the screen locked, and it uses less power than recording while streaming.

string.name: guide_record_quality_body
string.value: Choose it in Settings > Recording: High is 1080p at 12 Mbps (about 90 MB a minute), Standard is 1080p at 8 Mbps (about 60 MB), and Space saver is 720p at 4 Mbps (about 30 MB). 720p streams are recorded at 720p with a lower bitrate. Without an H.265 encoder, H.264 is used and files are somewhat larger.

string.name: guide_record_files_body
string.value: In the Recordings card below Dedicated hotspot on the home screen, where you can play, save to Gallery or delete them. Recordings stay inside the app and do not appear in Gallery until you tap Save to Gallery and confirm, which moves them there. Uninstalling the app deletes recordings that were not saved to Gallery.

string.name: guide_record_enhance_body
string.value: Picture enhancement can affect recordings. If something looks wrong in a recording, try turning picture enhancement off.

string.name: guide_record_loss_body
string.value: Recordings contain the frames that arrived: if frames are lost on the network, that part is missing from the recording too. USB is the most stable. While recording, the console is asked to keep one picture size (SFT 0.7.18 or later); with older versions, switching between 720p and 1080p starts a new file.

string.name: guide_record_power_body
string.value: Recording needs at least 1 GB of free space to start and stops by itself below 300 MB. Recording while streaming runs one more hardware decoder and an encoder, so it uses more power and gets warmer. For long recordings, plug in or use Record only.

string.name: guide_record_sound_body
string.value: Game sound is recorded too, even when Play game sound is off on this device (it just is not played here). If sound is turned off in SFT, the recording has no sound.
